an incident's description.html:
Checkout API is down

The checkout service returns 503 for every request since 10:42 UTC. See the dashboard and https://status.example.com, or https://example.com/runbooks/checkout for the runbook.
Paged: @on-call (primary).

lists, nested and numbered.html:
• Impact
    • EU customers cannot pay
    • US customers see retries
  • Cause: a bad deploy
  1. Roll back checkout@4.2.1
  2. Purge the CDN
  3. Watch the error rate
  1. Ten
  2. Eleven
